name: Atiesh, the Befouled Greatstaff
statusNote: Changed in Forever. Gives 6,600 experience instead of 9,550, 0.69 times as much. From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
You question why you are still alive. After all, you have in your possession an item of great evil. The answer is not clear, adventurer. I only do as I must.

Kel'Thuzad sits atop his throne in Naxxramas, plotting... He seeks that which you hold and holds that which you seek.

As for the base of the staff; the dwarf, Brann Bronzebeard, held it when he entered Ahn'Qiraj. He has left Ahn'Qiraj but the base of Atiesh remains.

Should you succeed in recovering the pieces, return them to me.
narrative.objectives: Anachronos at the Caverns of Time in Tanaris wants the Staff Head of Atiesh and the Base of Atiesh.
narrative.offerRewardText: There is a being within... a being not of this world.
narrative.requestItemsText: In its current form, the staff is far too dangerous to be in the hands of a mortal.

chain.subtitle: 6 quests at level 60, 23,150 XP in all.

quests.objectiveText: Find someone that will help you in recovering the last two pieces of the staff and ridding it of evil.
